To mirror your phone:

1. Connect your phone to Android Auto.
2. Open the Dem TV Ekran Yansıtma entry in the Android Auto launcher.
3. Unlock your phone and accept Android’s screen-capture confirmation.

If a permission request is pending, open Dem TV on the phone to resume it.

Screen mirroring is available in the Android Auto version of Dem TV.\n\nConnect that version to Android Auto, open Dem TV Ekran Yansıtma in the car launcher, then confirm screen capture on the unlocked phone.
Your played content will appear here.
